target: Explain existing CGMacros daily errors; not a deployable model
selection: Same64 earlier training days,29 earlier validation days,44 later evaluation days. Ridge/kernel, .1/1/10/100/1000; each arm independently selected by earlier MAPE thenMAE.
interpretation: Food-only control detects dietary co-occurrence, so better combined predictions would not prove physiological compensation. No calorie field or carbohydrate-derived features.
